description: The London Stock Exchange is partnering with Payward, the parent company of Kraken, to explore tokenising shares of the 100 largest London-listed companies through the xStocks protocol. The first batch is expected to launch in the coming weeks. Subject to regulatory approval, the LSE also plans to explore listing and trading these tokenised securities on its LSE 24 venue.
title: London Stock Exchange Joins Forces With Kraken Parent to Explore Tokenised UK Stocks

description: WhatsApp is testing an AI content label for channel updates on iOS, allowing admins to disclose media created or edited using artificial intelligence. The feature is available to some beta testers through TestFlight with version 26.34.10.70 and follows its rollout on Android. Admins can add the label through an update's context menu, after which it cannot be removed. WhatsApp may also detect some AI-generated media automatically. The feature could be particularly relevant in countries where AI disclosures are legally required.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Rolling Out AI Content Label for Channels on iOS

description: Dyson has launched the Dyson CameraJet smart toothbrush featuring a camera powered by Gap Optical Targeting to identify gaps between teeth and precision-floss while you brush. Gap Optical Targeting analyses 28 live images per second to identify and target gaps between teeth in real time. It is priced at $499 (roughly Rs. 47,000). It is currently available in the US.
title: Dyson Launches CameraJet Toothbrush With Camera and Wi-Fi Connectivity

description: WhatsApp recently teased an upcoming Scam Alert feature. Now, the Meta-owned platform seems to be working on another privacy-focused feature to protect users from unofficial clients web. The messaging platform is said to be testing a new warning for Android users that appears when they connect their account through an unofficial WhatsApp Web client. It shows up on the Linked devices screen and asks users to switch to the official WhatsApp Web.
title: WhatsApp Could Soon Show Warning for Unofficial Web Clients

description: Vivo and iQOO have updated the India prices of the T5x 5G and Z11x 5G across their respective storage configurations. The Vivo T5x 5G is now available from Rs. 27,999, while the iQOO Z11x 5G starts at Rs. 24,999. Both phones were introduced in India at lower prices in March and received further revisions after launch. The latest changes come as smartphone makers face higher component costs, particularly for DRAM and NAND memory, which have contributed to broader price increases across segments.
title: Vivo T5x 5G, iQOO Z11x 5G Get Price Hikes in India: See New Prices

description: Crypto attacks rose 67 percent month-on-month in August, with 50 incidents recorded by blockchain security firm PeckShield. Despite the increase in attack frequency, estimated losses fell 49.5 percent to $136.3 million from July. The Tectonic lending protocol accounted for about $74 million of the losses, while the remaining 49 incidents resulted in approximately $62.3 million in combined losses.
title: Crypto Sees 67 Percent Rise in Hacks, With $136 Million Lost in August

description: The Moto G Max was recently launched in India in the sub-Rs. 28,000 price range in India. The smartphone arrived in the country months after it was unveiled in select global markets. The 7,000mAh battery of the Moto G Max delivered nearly two days of battery life with slightly heavy usage, which is quite impressive. The rear camera performance is also among the best in this price range. However, the underpowered chipset, the same old design, and an LCD panel bring down the overall experience.
title: Moto G Max Review: Familiar Design, Genuinely Good Cameras

description: Poco F9 Ultra has been launched in select global markets as the new flagship smartphone from the Xiaomi sub-brand. The handset was unveiled along with the new Poco F9 Pro. The new phones are set to go on sale in select global markets via the Xiaomi online store. The Poco F9 Ultra is offered in Black and Dark Cherry colour options, while the Poco F9 Pro will be available for purchase in Aurora Green, Black, and White colourways. The Ultra model is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, while the Pro model features the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V SoC.
title: Poco F9 Ultra, Poco F9 Pro Launched With 200-Megapixel Camera, 185Hz AMOLED Display: Price, Features

description: Star Wars Zero Company launched to rave reviews on August 27, but weeks before the game's release, developer Bit Reactor reportedly furloughed most of its workers. According to a new report, 80 percent of the studio's employees were impacted by the furloughs.
title: Star Wars Zero Company Developer Bit Reactor Reportedly Furloughed Most of Its Employees Ahead of Launch

description: After the launch of the Redmi K100 Pro and the K100 Pro Max in China in August, details about the standard Redmi K100 model are now emerging. A Weibo Tipster claims the upcoming smartphone will offer an ultra-high refresh-rate display and a 10,000mAh battery.
title: Redmi K100 Tipped to Get 10,000mAh Battery, Ultra-High Refresh Rate Display

description: Oppo and Xiaomi have become the latest brands to increase the prices of several smartphones and tablets in India by up to Rs. 5,000. A tipster claims that the price hike affects several flagship and mid-range models across both device categories, including Oppo Find X9s, Xiaomi Pad 8, Redmi Pad 2, and Redmi 15A, which have received revisions across multiple RAM and storage configurations. The latest round of price hike comes amidst rising cost of memory components.
title: Oppo Find X9s, Xiaomi Pad 8, Redmi Pad 2, Redmi 15A Prices Hiked in India by Up to Rs 5,000

description: Poco X8 Power and Poco X8 key specifications and features have been revealed. The Poco X8 Power will be equipped with an octa-core Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chipset. The tech firm claims that the handset managed to score over 10,00,000 points on the AnTuTu benchmarking platform. Moreover, the Poco X8 Power will also feature 8GB of RAM, the same as the standard Poco X8. Both smartphones will also feature a 6.83-inch 1.5K AMOLED 12-bit display, with up to a 120Hz refresh rate, up to 3,500 nits peak brightness, HDR10+ support, 68 billion colours, TUV Rheinland Eye Protection certification, and Wet Touch Display 2.0. The two will also be equipped with an in-display fingerprint scanner for security.
title: Poco X8, Poco X8 Power Key Specifications and Features Announced Ahead of India Launch

description: MEXC has launched a Visa-powered Global Card offering up to 10 percent cashback in USDT. The card has no issuance, annual, or top-up fees, while purchase fees are waived until September 30. MEXC also offers an Earn product with advertised returns of up to 7 percent annually on eligible USDT subscriptions, without a lock-up period.
title: MEXC Introduces Crypto Visa Card With USDT Cashback and Apple Pay Integration

description: Samsung could bring its Scam Detection feature to the Galaxy S27 series, Galaxy S25 lineup and several recent foldable phones. References discovered in One UI 9 Beta 7 include model numbers associated with these devices, suggesting they are being considered for the feature. The software also points to possible Exynos 2700 and Qualcomm processors for the Galaxy S27 range, indicating that Samsung may retain its dual-chipset approach. However, the findings come from development code and do not confirm a public rollout.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Series May Get Scam Detection Alongside Galaxy S25 Series, and Older Flagships

description: Xiaomi 18 Fold reportedly surfaced on the Geekbench AI website with model number 2608BPX34C. It got a single-precision score of 629 points and a half-precision score of 799 points. It appears to have a quantised score of 634 points. It has an Xring O3 chip featuring two high-performance cores clocked at 4.36GHz. It has four cores clocked at 3.69GHz and four cores at 3.15GHz. The listing shows the phone with Android 17 and 16GB RAM.
title: Xiaomi 18 Fold With Xring O3 Chip Allegedly Surfaces on Geekbench Ahead of Launch

description: Xiaomi on Tuesday announced the launch date of two new magnetic power banks in India. The company is expected to expand its charging accessory lineup, headlined by the Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W, which debuted in select global markets earlier this year. The power bank supports up to 15W magnetic wireless charging and up to 22.5W wired charging through USB Type-C. Alongside, the Xiaomi Magnetic Power Bank 10000 45W will also debut.
title: Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W India Launch Date Revealed; Magnetic Power Bank 10000 45W to Tag Along

description: Samsung is reportedly planning to implement a unified camera strategy for the Galaxy S27 lineup. The brand is said to be testing the Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ models with the same 3x telephoto setup as the Pro model. Samsung is reportedly evaluating a 50-megapixel 1/1.9-inch sensor paired with a 4x telephoto lens for the Galaxy S27 Ultra. The company is said to be evaluating five Galaxy S27 Ultra prototypes.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Series Could See Major Camera Hardware Changes: Here's What You Need to Know

description: Oppo has started teasing various details about the upcoming Android 17-based ColorOS 17 update. The new ColorOS 17 is teased to ship with a new navigation bar, which will be placed on top of the app screens for a more uniform look across the UI. On top of this, the ColorOS 17 update will also introduce the new “Fluid Fusion” (translated from Chinese) animation engine. This is said to make transitions between screens smoother. Additionally, the tech firm has teased ColorOS 17 with a new feedback system. This will make the app screens stretch, squeeze, and respond based on how a user interacts with it.
title: Oppo Teases Android 17-Based ColorOS 17 With Fresh Animations and UI Design

description: Sony has launched Live TV on PS5, a live TV channel service, on PlayStation. The service adds over 100 live channels to the PS5 console, featuring movies, TV shows, sports, news, and other content. Live TV on PS5 is currently only available in the US.
title: Sony Launches Live TV Service on PS5, Bringing Movies, TV Shows, Sports and More to PlayStation Console

description: Vivo X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max are set to introduce faster 4K video recording, with their main cameras supporting 240fps capture. Interpolated 480fps and 960fps modes are also expected, while the Pro Max could feature a 200-megapixel telephoto camera and 3-degree stabilisation. Leaked material suggests the flagship will have a large circular rear camera module with a rotating ring. The Pro Max is also tipped to feature a 6.85-inch 144Hz LTPO display and a Dimensity 9600-series chipset.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Camera Details Revealed Ahead of Launch, Leak Reveals New Camera Island

description: Bitcoin is holding near the Rs. 75 lakh level after a strong August, but the outlook has become more cautious. Rising Japanese bond yields, higher oil prices and increased expectations of a September Fed rate hike could weigh on risk appetite. Institutional buying continues to provide support, while investors await US jobs and inflation data for further direction.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $79,200 as Japan Rate Hike Bets Raise Market Risks

description: Sony has announced that the next State of Play will be broadcast this week on September 3. The presentaiton will feature updates and announcements on first- and third-party games, including an extended look at Final Fantasy VII Revelation. The show will be followed by a State of Play Japan broadcast focussed on upcoming games from Japanese and Asian studios.
title: Sony's State of Play Broadcast Returns This Week, Final Fantasy VII Revelation Confirmed to Get Extended Look

description: Poco X8 5G with model number 2607DPC18G has appeared on Geekbench. It scored 849 points in single-core testing and 2,841 points in multi-core testing. The listing shows the octa-core Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 (SM6435) chipset and 12GB of RAM. The Poco X8 5G is scheduled to go official in India on September 4 at 12:00 pm IST. It will be launched alongside the Poco X8 Power 5G
title: Poco X8 5G Visits Geekbench Website Ahead of September 4 India Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy Book 6 was launched in the US on Monday as the latest addition to the Galaxy Book 6 lineup. The laptop can be configured with up to Intel Core 5 processor, paired with up to 1TB of onboard storage. It sports a 14-inch WUXGA LCD screen with a 16:10 aspect ratio. The Galaxy Book 6 supports Galaxy AI features, along with connected experiences across Galaxy devices. The laptop offers up to 25 hours of battery life on a single charge.
title: Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Launched With Up to Intel Core 5 Chip, Galaxy AI Features: Price, Specifications

description: Oppo’s Find X10 will be getting a lot of upgrades this year. A Weibo tipster says the upcoming phone will get a high-capacity 8,000mAh battery and a new primary camera. The leak also hints at a new type of display with ultra-wide colour gamut support.
title: Oppo Find X10 Key Specifications Leaked Ahead of Expected September Launch

description: OnePlus 16 key specifications and features have been tipped ahead of its launch. The leaker claims that the smartphone will sport the custom BOE Oriental Screen 4.0 with the X4 luminescent material. The screen is said to refresh at up to 165Hz. It might also feature a proprietary “display chip”, and the panel could be the industry's only display with three calibrations per chip. The OnePlus 16 will reportedly also feature Oppo’s next-generation “Bright Eyes Protection” technology, along with “ultra narrow” bezels.
title: OnePlus 16 to Launch With a Custom BOE Display, Notable Camera Upgrade, Tipster Claims

description: The Redmi Note 17 Pro Max 5G is headed to India after Xiaomi confirmed its upcoming availability through an X post. The company has not revealed the Indian launch date yet. The smartphone debuted in select global markets in August with a Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chipset, 6.83-inch AMOLED display and up to 512GB storage. Other specifications include a 50-megapixel OIS-equipped main camera, 32-megapixel front camera, 10,000mAh silicon-carbon battery, 100W charging, IP68 protection and HyperOS 3.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max 5G India Launch Teased

description: Huawei Mate XT 2 will be launched on September 7 in China. It has an inward-folding design and an octagonal rear camera module. Huawei has opened pre-reservations for the tri-fold smartphone in China. It will be available in 16GB + 512GB and 16GB + 1TB RAM and storage configurations. It will be launched in Dark Black, Jin Zi and Pure White shades (translated from Chinese).
title: Huawei Mate XT 2 Launch Date Confirmed; Colourways, RAM and Storage Configurations Revealed

description: Instagram is introducing stricter disclosure rules for profiles built around AI-generated people. Accounts that do not identify their AI-generated identity could lose access to recommendations, while creators who add the new disclosure will not face a reach penalty. The platform is also replacing its AI creator label with AI-generated profile. Instagram will allow affected creators to restore recommendation eligibility by adding the label or appealing the decision through Account Status. The requirement does not apply to creators who only use AI tools during content creation.
title: Instagram Renames AI Creator Label, Limits Reach of Undisclosed Profiles

description: Tim Cook sent his last internal memo to Apple employees as the CEO of the tech giant on Monday. The executive started by acknowledging that it is his last day at Apple in the capacity of a CEO. “This is a moment I always knew would come one day, and yet it is still hard to believe it has arrived and I am writing these words.” Showing his gratitude towards his peers, Cook said, “I love this company and the team behind it, and I couldn’t let this day pass without sending a note to you, to tell you how grateful I am for the outpouring of affection you’ve sent my way, for the way you’ve shown up each and every day, and most of all, for the privilege of a lifetime serving as your leader.”
title: Tim Cook Pens His Last Memo as Apple CEO for Employees, Says ‘There Is Something Truly Special About Apple’

description: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) on Monday issued an advisory against rising financial fraud involving malicious Android apps that were found to be masquerading as pornography apps. According to the National Cybercrime Threat Analytics Unit (NCTAU), the apps are being promoted under various names through advertisements on social media platforms under Meta Platforms’ umbrella. Once installed, the malicious apps are capable of providing threat actors with extensive control over an affected device.
title: Govt Warns Against Malicious Android Apps Disguised As Adult Content That Can Enable Financial Fraud

description: Apple is said to be undergoing yet another major leadership change following Tim Cook’s last day as Chief Executive Officer. According to a report, veteran executive Phil Schiller stepping down from his remaining responsibilities overseeing the App Store and Apple’s product events. The App Store will reportedly return to the Services division, while Apple’s events team is expected to get a new leader.
title: Apple Leadership Shakeup on Tim Cook's Last Day: Phil Schiller Steps Down, Eddy Cue Gets App Store Back

description: John Ternus has taken over as the new Chief Executive Officer of Apple from Tim Cook. He has been associated with the tech giant for the last 25 years, joining Apple’s product design team in 2001. Before Apple, the executive worked as a mechanical engineer at Virtual Research Systems after completing his bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Pennsylvania. Heading the hardware design team at Apple, Ternus has been responsible for introducing various innovations with a special focus on reliability and durability. He led the team to introduce the use of newer materials and hardware design, which the company says has helped make Apple products more resilient, while reducing Apple’s carbon footprint.
title: John Ternus Takes Over as the New Apple CEO: Five Things to Know
